now.title: Loki S2
now.text: B-15 helps Loki and Mobius track Sylvie, Dox and Renslayer as the Temporal Loom fails. After Loki saves the timelines, B-15 becomes one of the TVA's new leaders.
cases: ST-110 The Failure of the Temporal Loom (Loki S2)

changes.evidence: In Loki S2 B-15 is never in Broxton or Chicago: Loki, Mobius and Brad Wolfe go to the Broxton McDonald's (ep 2) and Loki and Mobius go to 1893 Chicago (ep 3) while B-15 stays at the TVA with Casey and Ouroboros tracking Dox's attack and Renslayer's TemPad. Her only trip off the TVA is London 1977, where she ambushes X-5 and takes his TemPad (ep 2).

now.title: Loki S2
now.text: In episode 2, X-5 deserts the TVA to become movie star Brad Wolfe, but Loki and Mobius bring him in.

changes.evidence: Loki S2 episode 2: the TVA finds X-5 living as actor Brad Wolfe in London, 1977, where Loki, Mobius and B-15 catch him before bringing him to the TVA holding room; the record shows only the TVA.
